headline: New Wallingford High School site study and education specifications, enrollment projection study, and Superintendent's 2026-27 goals and evaluation.
summary: The agenda includes a geotechnical study for a proposed new Wallingford High School site. It also covers education specifications for a new high school, the superintendent's goals and evaluation, and an enrollment projection study.
items: Recognize 2026 District Paraeducator of the Year, Crystalin Czentnar, Parker Farms Elementary School
Recognize 2026 District Teacher of the Year, Alison Gibertoni, Parker Farms Elementary School
Recognize 2026 District Administrator of the Year, Anthony Mangiafico, Wallingford Adult Education Director
Student board representatives
Public comment
Consent agenda: October 2026 financial report, including financial projection report, year-to-date budget report, and use of 2% fund
Transfer of funds from Contingency, 2601400 100B, to Account 4000400 739A 23006 for Mark T. Sheehan High School's Doors
Waterfall / 10 Year Capital Improvement Plan - 1.28.26
Enrollment Projection Study by MP Planning Group
Due diligence services: geotechnical study by Langan for proposed one new Wallingford High School site
October 2026 cafeteria/food service financial report

Proposed adoption or revisions: Italian 3; Policy 5131 - Student Discipline; Policy 5141.3 - Health Assessments and Screenings; Policy 5131.311 - Immunizations; Policy 4152.6/4252.6 - Family Medical Leave Act; Bylaw 9311 - Formulation, Adoption, Amendment or Deletion of Policies; Regulation 5145.4a - Administrative Regulations Regarding Students and Section 504 and Title II of the ADA
Items removed from the consent agenda
Correspondence
Committee reports: ACES governing board representative, system-wide PTAC, special education PTAC, CABE, and Wallingford Adult Education Advisory Council
Executive session: superintendent's goals and evaluation for 2026-27, leaves of absence for certified staff, and resignations for certified staff
Instructional committee: possible approval of superintendent's goals and evaluation for 2026-27, leaves of absence for certified staff, and resignations for certified staff
Operations committee report
Revise authorized signers of ED-099 Agreement for Child Nutrition Programs to Danielle Bellizzi and Carrie LaTorre
Discussion and possible approval of proposed education specifications for one new Wallingford High School
Discussion and possible approval of proposed ASTE education specifications for one new Wallingford High School
Administrative report
Announcements: Operations Committee and Instructional Committee meetings on November 16, 2026
Next meeting: November 23, 2026
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Suite 2, Wallingford
